items.headline: Aidan Chiles throws for 3 TDs, runs for another: Northwestern rips Ball State 45-14
items.description: — Aidan Chiles passed for three touchdowns for the second time this season and ran for another as Northwestern routed Ball State 45-14 in a non-conference matchup on Saturday.

items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 5: Michigan is back for more
items.description: Apparently the Wolverines were so comfortable on our dubious list last week, they decided to stick around.

items.headline: Miller and Walendzak combine for nearly 300 yards rushing, lead Toledo to 39-24 win over Ball State
items.description: — CJ Miller and Connor Walendzak combined for 299 yards rushing and three touchdowns to lead Toledo to a 39-24 victory over Ball State on Saturday in the Mid-American Conference opener for the Rockets.
